{"id":1578903141,"question_id":3475,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 year, 4 months","timestamp":1742376916,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"3 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1578903141/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Minimum Operations to Make Binary Array Elements Equal to One I","memory":"140 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int minOperations(vector<int>& nums) {\n        int n = nums.size();\n        int count =0;\n        int i = 0;\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<n-2  ; i++)\n        {\n            if(nums[i] == 0)\n            {\n                nums[i] = 1 - nums[i];\n                nums[i+1] = 1 - nums[i+1];\n                nums[i+2] = 1 - nums[i+2];\n                count++;\n            }\n        }\n        if(nums[n-1] == 0 || nums[n-2] == 0)\n        return -1;\n        \n    return count;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"minimum-operations-to-make-binary-array-elements-equal-to-one-i","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":471}
